info.name: OCI Cache Oci Cache Default Config Set API
Return a list of OCI Cache Default Config Set.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The unique identifier for the compartment.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique OCI Cache Default Config Set identifier.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description: A filter to return the OCI Cache Default Config Set resources, whose lifecycle state matches with the given lifecycle state.

params.name: softwareVersion
params.description: A filter to return the OCI Cache Config Set resources, whose software version matches with the given software version.

params.name: displayName
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the entire display name given.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. Default order for timeCreated is descending. Default order for displayName is ascending.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description: A token representing the position at which to start retrieving results. This must come from the `opc-next-page` header field of a previous response.

items.docs: Lists the OCI Cache Default Config Sets in the specified compartment.

info.name: Get a OCI Cache Default Config Set by OCID.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The unique identifier for the compartment.

params.name: ociCacheDefaultConfigSetId
params.description: Unique OCI Cache Default Config Set identifier.

items.docs: Retrieves the specified OCI Cache Default Config Set.
